channels.email.setup.title: Set up Email Channels
channels.email.trust.missing: Internal mail lacks the trust markers this strategy needs.
channels.email.setup.description: Connect a mailbox so people can email your sessions. Happier reads new mail and replies in the same thread.
channels.email.setup.accountDescription: The mailbox login Happier uses to read and send mail. Add one in Connected services.
channels.email.setup.trustDescription: How Happier confirms a sender is who they claim to be before an agent reads their mail.
channels.email.setup.exchangeDescription: Trust the sender checks your Exchange organization records.
channels.email.setup.authResultsDescript: Trust the SPF, DKIM and DMARC results your receiving server adds.
channels.email.setup.domainsDescription: Only addresses at these domains can join a conversation. Separate them with commas; leave empty to allow any domain.
channels.email.setup.historyDescription: What to keep from earlier messages quoted in a reply.
channels.email.setup.bodyFormatDescripti: How replies are written. Markdown unless you choose plain text.
